reason: World-step and thread records could say money changed hands or went missing with no money operation, so household books never moved (the Duvals' savings tin, Jan 1950: books unchanged, no amount ever known). Adds the requirement to the options format, and when an option says money moved without a money operation, asks the model once to add the exact amount (or reword). The odds are kept exactly as first estimated and the dice pick among the same options.
